name: helmi-ops
description: Diagnose, monitor, and audit network devices with local evidence and read-only Helmi probes.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first network diagnostics and configuration safety.
interface.longDescription: Use a local Helmi Runtime for safe device and Prometheus reads, with Helmi Cloud for bounded diagnostic knowledge and metric-candidate advice.
defaultPrompt: Add or manage a device and connect its Prometheus monitoring.
Check a device's reachability and interface health with safe read-only probes.
Capture a redacted configuration baseline and check for changes.
